```yaml
name: CI/CD and Release Infrastructure

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [linux, windows, macos]
        architecture: [x86_64]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Check for changes
        run: cargo check --all

      - name: Format code
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

      - name: Run Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all -- -D warnings

      - name: Test
        run: cargo test --all

      - name: Build for multiple platforms
        run: |
          mkdir -p target/release
          cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu -j $(nproc)
          cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc -j $(nproc)
          cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin -j $(nproc)

  release:
    needs: ci
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Create release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Upload binaries
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ github.ref }}
          file: |
            target/release/azul-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            target/release/azul-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe
            target/release/azul-x86_64-apple-darwin
          asset_name: azul-${{ github.ref }}-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.arch }}

  sync-version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Sync version
        run: |
          echo "version = \"0.0.7\"" > Cargo.toml
          git add Cargo.toml
          git commit -m "chore: bump version to 0.0.7"
          git push origin main

  update-readme:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Update README
        run: |
          echo "[![CI](https://github.com/0xSero/Azul/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/0xSero/Azul/actions/workflows/ci.yml)" >> README.md
          echo "[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/0xSero/Azul?label=release&color=brightgreen)](https://github.com/0xSero/Azul/releases/latest)" >> README.md
          echo "## Installation" >> README.md
          echo "To install Azul, download the binary for your platform from the [releases page](https://github.com/0xSero/Azul/releases)." >> README.md
          echo "## Workflow Documentation" >> README.md
          echo "For more information on our CI/CD and release processes, see the [GitHub Actions documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/actions)." >> README.md
          git add README.md
          git commit -m "chore: update README with badges, installation instructions, and workflow docs"
          git push origin main

  makefile:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Create Makefile
        run: |
          cat <<EOF > Makefile
          dev:
              cargo run

          install:
              cargo install --path .

          version:
              @echo "Version: \$(shell grep '^version =' Cargo.toml | cut -d'=' -f2)"
          EOF
          git add Makefile
          git commit -m "chore: add Makefile with dev, install, and versioning commands"
          git push origin main
```
